hook.h2: The one who leads the singing is being sung over
hook.text: Your Father is in your midst, a mighty warrior who saves. He will rejoice over you with gladness; he will quiet you by his love; he will exult over you with loud singing.
father: Your Father is in your midst, a mighty warrior who saves. He will rejoice over you with gladness; he will quiet you by his love; he will exult over you with loud singing.
hook.note: Every word of this verse is our Father speaking, which is why the whole of it is BLUE — and what He says is that He is the one singing. You spend your weeks building a room where people can sing to Him; He was already singing over you while you did it. Not quietly, either: the Hebrew is loud singing, the kind you would lead.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Asaph led worship for a king and came within a step of losing his faith. What steadied him was not better music. It was walking into the sanctuary and finding he was already held: "Nevertheless, I am continually with you; you hold my right hand."
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Receive The Father. Hear His Voice. His Heart Is For You.
body: The Worship Leader’s Bible is a color coded Bible for worship leaders, church leaders, musicians and singers — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.

long.h: You Lead The Singing. Your Father Wants To Fill You First.
body: You stand in front of the room and carry other people into His presence. Asaph led worship for a king and still came within a step of losing his faith. What steadied him was not better music. It was walking in and finding he was already held: "Nevertheless, I am continually with you; you hold my right hand."

Your Heavenly Father is not waiting for you to lead well before He speaks. This is a praise and worship Bible built for intimacy with God — a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading, so you hear Him for yourself before you carry anyone else.

long.h: A Three Color Bible: Red Letter, Blue Letter, Purple Letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Worship Leader's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — bound and opened for the person who leads. The cover and the opening pages are what change: a word about Asaph, who led worship for a king and still nearly lost his footing, a prayer to pray, and passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance chosen for someone who is usually pouring out. From Genesis 1:1 onward the text is identical to every other edition.

faq.q: Is the color in the Psalms too?
faq.a: Genesis to Revelation, every divine voice, on every page — all 150 Psalms included. It is not a red-letter New Testament with a black Old Testament, and not a colored section at the back. In the Psalms in particular it does real work: you can see the moment the singer stops speaking and our Father answers.

faq.q: Can I use it for songwriting and set lists?
faq.a: That is one of the reasons worship leaders buy it. The color tells you which lines are our Father's own words rather than a writer's words about Him — useful when you are deciding what a congregation is about to sing back to Him. On quoting the text: up to 500 verses may be used without written permission, provided they are not more than a quarter of the work and not a whole book of the Bible; church bulletins, orders of service and projected slides just need the initials FHB after the quotation.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a praise team or a worship pastor?
faq.a: Yes — a complete case-laminate hardcover Bible and a presentation page for a name, which is why it also works for an ordination or a pastor appreciation gift. If you are buying for the whole team, the volume discounts on the print page start at ten copies and can be mixed across any of the sixteen editions.

It is the complete Bible, and what a worship leader receives here first is our Father's own voice — including the verse where He is the one singing over you. The 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar: 1,075 explain a word, name, custom or background, 248 mark where the text reveals the Father, and 31 record a difference among the manuscripts.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
